# Captured Lombard source fixture

SHA-256 `8744a2e1fc36719f0ba0b9040664bd62b4d9df2719e65c2d14007c214e6a31e7`,
OSM base `2026-09-29T06:06:17Z`. It retains the 18 priority node-via conditional
